description: Atlas evidence: submit an asset id or ticker. The signed report follows each of the six rights fields across the published dataset versions the server reads, the public API’s current version and the earlier version bundled with the server, naming the version stamps where a field moved between disclosed and not disclosed or its value, detail or sources changed. An asset present only in the current version returns current_version_only with its current state. POST /api/atlas-rights-history. Reads the published Tokenization Atlas dataset at https://atlas.weverlabs.com/api/assets once per call, with no dataset writes and no issuer contact. Every report names the dataset version it read, and a field or history the dataset does not hold is reported as not in the published dataset. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/atlas-evidence-contract. Human page: https://atlas.weverlabs.com/.

asset.description: An Atlas asset id or ticker as it appears in the dataset, matched case-insensitively. Example: paxg or PAXG.
